item.title: Rust GCC Compiler Backend: Install rustc-codegen-gcc with One Command
item.description: rustc-codegen-gcc is now officially part of rustup nightly components. Linux users can now experience GCC-compiled Rust code with a single command. No more manual compilation, no more environment setup hassles—it's like giving Rust a new engine.
